scope: Recoverable paired Folder clean exit across Android, relay and Linux; development acceptance, not live deployment

Shared content preserved until no other pending Folder references it
Owned tus fragments removed and old admitted writers cannot recreate data
Injected filesystem cleanup failure retains ownership for retry
Credential rechecked inside the server write transaction
Linux owned-state cleanup, original preservation, stale receiver barrier and receipt removal
Existing directory, tus, transfer and recovery regressions

linux_layout.backend: Owned Broadway display and headless browser, not the real desktop

new_ownership_tests: Find staging whose queue transaction did not commit without claiming another Folder
Reject unowned legacy payloads without deleting them
Reject an ownership marker that disagrees with the transfer queue

android_broad_regression.difference_from_final_runtime_source: Only RelayStore.finishDisconnect SQL gained AND exit_phase IS NULL, preventing a stale ordinary-disconnect callback from clearing a pending exit credential

cases: Cancel exit, then clean owned staging including an uncommitted import, preserve source bytes and wait for Linux receipt
Offline exit keeps a durable stop barrier, credential and staging
Peer-requested exit keeps directory permission used by another Folder
Ordinary disconnection still needs confirmation and retains files
Failed disconnection retains its credential and blocks stale work
Legacy removal remains local and retains files
Initialize an existing directory and wait for pairing confirmation
45-file initial backlog automatically crosses bounded batches, reaches Linux and is acknowledged

failed_attempts_retained: folder-clean-exit-device: ambiguous duplicate-text UI locator; fixed to select the dialog
folder-clean-exit-device-verified and folder-clean-exit-device-final: HTTP/1.0 test proxy forced fresh emulator NAT connections; 42/45 uploads completed before the unchanged 90-second bound

folder-clean-exit-http11: HTTP/1.1 proxy made all 8 directory cases pass, including the 45-file test in 21.494 seconds; exposed an Auto test race between durable completion and subsequent staging deletion
Auto assertion now waits up to 5 seconds for staging deletion; durable receipt-before-delete ordering is unchanged
limitations: These counts describe distinct scopes and repeated runs must not be added together as unique tests
Not a full release or physical-phone/compositor performance qualification
Exit filesystem failures and uncommitted-import crash states were injected; SIGKILL runs cover transfer recovery, not every exit instruction boundary
Relay schema 5 and Android schema 7 require upgrade; old binaries must not reopen upgraded databases
Offline or old peers stay pending; minimal receipts, hashes and Linux lock/retirement markers intentionally remain
Legacy shared-token Folders cannot be independently retired
Unattributed legacy staging and custom/unverified Linux paths need manual review
Original files, received files and conflict copies are never cleanup targets
No live server deployment, real-phone installation, installed-Linux-app replacement, release signing, commit or push
